name: Kazakhstan
description: Kazakhstan from the Botai horse herders and the Silk Road to the Kazakh Khanate, Russian and Soviet rule, Baikonur and independence.

checkpoints.name: The steppe
checkpoints.note: The Botai people tamed horses on the steppe. Scythians, Turks and Mongols followed, and Silk Road towns grew in the south.

checkpoints.name: The Kazakh Khanate
checkpoints.note: The Kazakhs formed their khanate in the 1460s. The Russian empire took the steppe in the 1700s and 1800s.

checkpoints.name: Soviet Kazakhstan
checkpoints.note: Collectivisation caused a terrible famine. Baikonur sent Gagarin to space, the bomb was tested at Semipalatinsk, and the virgin lands were ploughed.

checkpoints.name: Independent Kazakhstan
checkpoints.note: Kazakhstan became independent in 1991, grew rich on oil and built a new capital at Astana.
